tiktok.caption: Waiting to save whatever's left each month? That one habit has a $384,000 price tag — and the fix takes 5 minutes.

youtube_short.title: The 'Save What's Left' Trap Is Stealing $384K
title_alternatives: Why You Keep Running Out of Money to Save
The #1 Saving Mistake That Costs You $384,000
youtube_short.description: Most people save whatever's left at the end of the month — and statistically, that's almost nothing. Studies show leftover-savers average just $127/month, while people who auto-transfer on payday save $441/month. That $314 monthly gap compounds to $384,000 over 30 years at 7%. The fix is simple: automate your savings BEFORE you touch your paycheck. Your brain can't spend what it never sees. Follow for more money traps like this! #personalfinance #savingmoney #wealthbuilding #financetips #moneyhacks
